en.name: Takuan
en.summary: Takuan is daikon sun-dried and then pickled, traditionally buried in a bed of rice bran and salt. The traditional version is not a fridge food at all; the modern supermarket kind — low-salt, sweetened, coloured and pasteurised — is, keeping 1–3 months once the pack is opened.
en.pantry: Traditional takuan is not a fridge food. The method is to sun-dry whole daikon, then layer them with rice bran and salt under a weight at 15–17 percent salt, and ferment for six to twelve months. The salt is the preservation, and a whole radish left buried in its bran bed in a cool place keeps as long as the bed does — historically it was salted three to five times more heavily than today's version. Modern supermarket takuan is nothing like this: low in salt, sweetened, coloured and pasteurised, and it belongs in the fridge whatever the traditional product does.
en.fridge: For a genuinely fermented, high-salt takuan lifted out of its bran and kept cold, 4–6 months is the working figure — the published figure for fully fermented pickles in their original container, refrigerated, with surface scum and moulds removed regularly. The same rule applies to a crock of 糠漬け. For an opened vacuum pack of the modern seasoned type, reckon on 1–3 months: keep the slices submerged in whatever liquid came with them, in a sealed box at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. That figure is borrowed from pickles generally; no agency publishes one for takuan. Sliminess on the surface, or a lifted, gassy pack, means discard it.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for takuan and freezing it works against the point. Its entire character is the crunch of a salted, dried, fermented radish, and freezing bursts what is left of the cell structure so that the slices thaw limp and weeping. It is already a preserve with months of life in it; the freezer adds nothing. If you have a whole radish, leave it in its bran bed, which is where it keeps best.
spoilage: A slimy or ropy film on the surface of the slices
A lifted, domed or gassy vacuum pack
Fuzzy mould, as distinct from the surface bloom on a traditional bran bed
A rotten or off smell rather than the sharp, funky, fermented one
tips: Keep the slices submerged in their liquid and use a clean dry utensil.
Skim surface scum from a crock of bran pickles regularly.
A bright yellow colour usually means dye, not turmeric — it says nothing about freshness.
Rinse traditional high-salt takuan before serving if it is too salty; do not rinse the modern sweetened kind.

faq.q: How long does takuan keep after opening?
faq.a: 1–3 months refrigerated for an opened pack of the modern seasoned type, borrowed from pickles generally. A genuinely fermented high-salt takuan keeps 4–6 months refrigerated with regular skimming.
The modern supermarket kind does — it is low-salt, sweetened and pasteurised. Traditional high-salt takuan buried in its bran bed keeps in a cool place as long as the bed does.
There is no timeline and no reason to. It is already a preserve, and freezing turns the crunch that defines it into limp, weeping slices.

faq.q: Why is my takuan so yellow?
faq.a: Usually dye. Traditionally the colour came from the drying and the bran; most supermarket takuan is coloured, and the shade tells you nothing about how fresh or how well made it is.

zh.name: 澤庵漬
zh.summary: 澤庵漬是把白蘿蔔曬乾後再醃漬的產品，傳統做法是埋在米糠和鹽的糠床裡。傳統版本根本不是冷藏食品；而現在超市賣的那種——低鹽、加糖、染色又經過殺菌——則是，開封後可放 1～3 個月。
zh.pantry: 傳統的澤庵漬不是冷藏食品。做法是把整根白蘿蔔曬乾，再和米糠、鹽層層堆疊，上面壓重石，鹽度達 15～17%，發酵六到十二個月。真正在保存它的是鹽，而一整根埋在糠床裡的蘿蔔，放在陰涼處可以和糠床一樣久——歷史上的鹽度是現在版本的三到五倍。現代超市的澤庵漬完全是另一回事：低鹽、加糖、染色、殺菌，不論傳統產品怎麼做，它都該放冰箱。
zh.fridge: 如果是真正發酵、高鹽、從糠床裡取出來低溫保存的澤庵漬，4～6 個月是工作上的參考數字——這是「完全發酵的醃漬品保存在原容器中冷藏、並定期撈除表面浮渣與黴」的公布數字，同樣適用於一缸糠漬。至於現代調味型的真空包裝開封後，請抓 1～3 個月：把蘿蔔片壓在原本附的醃汁裡，密封盒裝好放 4°C 以下。這個數字是比照醃漬類整體而來；沒有任何單位為澤庵漬公布過。表面變黏，或真空包鼓脹產氣，就要丟棄。
zh.freezer: 澤庵漬沒有冷凍保存期限，冷凍也違背它的意義。它的全部個性就在那股醃漬乾蘿蔔的脆度，而冷凍會撐破僅存的細胞結構，解凍後只剩軟塌出水的蘿蔔片。它本身就是保存品、還有好幾個月的壽命，冷凍什麼也沒增加。如果拿到的是一整根，就讓它留在糠床裡，那才是它最好的歸宿。
spoilage: 蘿蔔片表面出現黏滑或牽絲的薄膜
真空包鼓起、隆起或明顯產氣
長出毛狀黴（這和傳統糠床表面的正常菌膜不同）
有腐臭味或異味，而不是那股尖銳的發酵香
tips: 把蘿蔔片壓在醃汁底下，並使用乾淨的乾器具。
糠床的表面浮渣要定期撈掉。
鮮黃色多半是色素而不是薑黃——顏色完全不能用來判斷新鮮度。
傳統高鹽澤庵太鹹的話，上桌前沖一下；現代加糖的那種不要沖。

faq.q: 澤庵漬開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 現代調味型的開封後冷藏 1～3 個月，這是比照醃漬類而來。真正發酵的高鹽澤庵冷藏可放 4～6 個月，並要定期撈除表面浮渣。
現代超市那種要——它低鹽、加糖又經過殺菌。傳統高鹽、埋在糠床裡的澤庵，放在陰涼處可以和糠床一樣久。
沒有對應的期限，也沒有理由。它本身就是保存品，而冷凍會把定義它的那份脆度變成軟塌出水的蘿蔔片。
通常是色素。傳統上顏色來自曬乾和米糠；現在市售的多半經過染色，顏色深淺完全說明不了新鮮度或製作品質。
